点一行跳到改它的提交；上下键选行，回车跳转: Click a line to jump to the commit that changed it; use Up/Down to select a line, Enter to jump
点仓库在新标签页里打开。: Click a repository to open it in a new tab.
点关闭按钮只是藏起窗口；退出在托盘图标的右键菜单里。: The close button only hides the window; quit from the tray icon's context menu.
点改动的行选中，Shift 连选；空格暂存，Delete 丢弃: Click lines · Space: stage · Del: discard
点目录进去；仓库会克隆到选中的目录下面: Click a directory to enter it; the repository will be cloned into the selected directory
点目录进去；标着「仓库」的可以打开: Click a directory to enter it; those marked “Repository” can be opened
点选一个提交查看改动: Select a commit to view its changes
现在是分离的 HEAD，先切换到一个分支: HEAD is detached; switch to a branch first
现在是分离的 HEAD，先切换到一个分支再拉取: HEAD is detached; switch to a branch before pulling
现在是分离的 HEAD，先切换到一个分支再推送: HEAD is detached; switch to a branch before pushing
由服务器去连远程仓库；放仓库的目录要已经存在。: The server connects to the remote repository; the parent directory must already exist.
登录 Windows 后自动启动；开了托盘选项时直接进托盘。: Starts automatically after you sign in to Windows; goes straight to the system tray if a tray option is on.
登录被拒绝：密钥或密码不对，或者取消了输入: Sign-in rejected: wrong key or password, or the prompt was cancelled
端口要填 1～65535 的数字: Port must be a number from 1 to 65535
等「{running}」做完再试: Wait for “{running}” to finish, then try again
等待 git 结束失败: Failed to wait for git to exit
能快进就快进，不能就生成合并提交。: Fast-forward when possible; otherwise create a merge commit.
能打开服务器上仓库的 Git 客户端：本机和服务器上的仓库用同一套界面。: A Git client that can open repositories on servers: one interface for local and server repositories.
获取和推送都改用这个地址。: Use this address for both fetching and pushing.
获取完成，已清理远程删除的分支: Fetch complete; branches deleted on the remote have been pruned
获取，并清理远程已删除的分支（--prune）: Fetch and prune branches deleted on the remote (--prune)
被拒绝：远程分支上有本地没有的提交。先拉取再推送。: Rejected: the remote branch has commits you don't have locally. Pull, then push.
认证没通过。检查用户名、密码或密钥有没有这个仓库的权限。: Authentication failed. Check that the username, password, or key has access to this repository.
读取消息附带的数据时连接中断: Connection lost while reading attached message data
跳过正在重放的这个提交：它的改动（包括已解决的冲突）会被丢掉，变基接着处理后面的: Skip the commit being replayed: its changes (including resolved conflicts) will be discarded, and the rebase continues with the rest.
转发本机的 ssh-agent（只对信任的服务器开）: Forward the local ssh-agent (trusted servers only)
还有 {left} 处冲突没解决：每处选一边，或在「手动编辑」里改好再保存。: {left} {left|conflict is|conflicts are} still unresolved: pick a side for each, or fix them under “Edit manually”, then save.
还有不完整的冲突标记（<<<<<<<、=======、>>>>>>>）。在「手动: Incomplete conflict markers remain (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>). Remove them under “Edit manually”, then save.
还有没解决的冲突。到「本地修改」里解决后再试。: There are unresolved conflicts. Resolve them in “Local changes”, then try again.
还没提交：检查后点上面的「提交合并」，不要了点「中止」。: Not committed yet: review it, then click “Commit merge” above, or “Abort” to drop it.
还没有本机仓库。点「添加本机仓库…」或「克隆…」。: No local repositories yet. Click “Add local repository…” or “Clone…”.
还没有记录。提交、切换分支、获取、推送之后会列在这里。: Nothing recorded yet. Commits, branch switches, fetches and pushes are listed here once they run.
还没有这台服务器上的仓库。点「打开仓库…」挑一个。: No repositories on this server yet. Click “Open repository…” to pick one.
还没有；提交过的说明会记在这里: None yet; messages are remembered here after you commit
这个仓库正在{op}，关掉标签页会取消它。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; closing the tab will cancel it.
这个仓库正在{op}，等它做完再关。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; wait for it to finish before closing.
这个仓库正在{op}，等它做完再移。: “{op}” is in progress in this repository; wait for it to finish before moving it.
这个仓库还没有远程。先在侧栏「远程」上右键「添加远程…」。: This repository has no remotes yet. Right-click “Remotes” in the sidebar and choose “Add remote…” first.
这个分支没有上游，推送一次会自动设好。: This branch has no upstream. Pushing sets it automatically.
这个分支还有没合并进来的提交。: This branch has commits that have not been merged yet.
这个名字已经有了，换一个。: This name is already in use. Choose another.
这个工作区里有标签页正在做操作，等它做完再删。: Some tabs in this workspace have operations in progress; wait for them to finish before deleting it.
这个工作区里没有开着的标签页。: This workspace has no open tabs.
这个提交不在当前分支上。先切换到包含它的分支。: This commit is not on the current branch. Switch to a branch that contains it first.
这个提交之后有 {n} 个提交，一次最多整理 {max} 个。选近一点的提交。: There are {n} commits after this one; at most {max} can be rebased at once. Pick a more recent commit.
这个提交之后没有别的提交，不用整理。: There are no commits after this one, so there is nothing to rebase.
这个提交里文件还叫别的名字，下面是全部改动 ·: The file had a different name in this commit; all of the commit's changes are shown below ·
这个文件不是 UTF-8 编码，这里改不了。在外部编辑器里解决后，回「本地修改」: This file is not UTF-8 and can't be edited here. Resolve it in an external editor, then click “Mark as resolved” in “Local changes”.
这个目录是仓库，可以打开: This directory is a repository and can be opened
这个系统上还不支持开机自启: Automatic startup is not yet supported on this system
这个系统上还不能保存密码: Saving passwords is not supported on this system
这是 git 或 ssh 的原始提示，填的内容不会保存。: This is the original prompt from git or ssh. Your input is not saved.
这是公钥，要选不带 .pub 的私钥文件: This is a public key; choose the private key file without .pub
远程的名字里不能有空格和斜杠: Remote names cannot contain spaces or slashes
连不上远程。检查网络、代理和远程地址。: Cannot connect to the remote. Check the network, proxy, and remote address.
连续滚动（每帧 {BENCH_ROWS_PER_FRAME} 行）帧间隔: Continuous scrolling ({BENCH_ROWS_PER_FRAME} rows per frame) frame interval
选一个文件查看改动: Select a file to view its changes
选一个文件，看它的历史或逐行追溯: Select a file to view its history or blame
里面的 {tabs} 个标签页会关掉，仓库还在列表里。: The {tabs} {tabs|tab|tabs} in it will close; the repositories stay in the list.
顺序和做法都没改，没有变基。: Nothing was changed, so no rebase was run.
马上生效；已弹出的通知不变。: Takes effect immediately; notifications already shown do not change.
